answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 1583 Country: AU Title: My parents had send me one bedsheet which have some Disney cartoon characters. Can i use that bedsheet? Question: My parents had send me one bedsheet which have some Disney cartoon characters. Can i use that bedsheet? Answer ID: 1583 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 953/953=J) It is allowable to use it as bed sheet, sit and sleep over it, but it is not better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
